# Yahoo
> Yahoo is a consumer web platform for news, finance, sports, mail, search, entertainment, weather, and lifestyle content.

Yahoo aggregates editorial coverage and service experiences across major consumer categories, including real-time market data, sports scores, email, search, and original reporting. Its ecosystem spans dedicated verticals such as Yahoo News, Finance, Sports, Entertainment, Life, and Mail, along with account and search services.

## Core Services
- [Yahoo Homepage](https://www.yahoo.com/): Main portal for news, finance, sports, entertainment, weather, and featured stories.
- [Yahoo Mail](https://mail.yahoo.com/): Webmail service for personal email, inbox management, and account access.
- [Yahoo Search](https://search.yahoo.com/): Search engine for web results, images, videos, and general discovery.
- [My Yahoo](https://my.yahoo.com/): Personalized start page for feeds, widgets, weather, and saved interests.
- [Yahoo Account](https://login.yahoo.com/): Sign-in and account access for Yahoo consumer services.

## News
- [Yahoo News](https://www.yahoo.com/news/): Breaking news hub covering U.S., world, politics, science, and major events.
- [U.S. News](https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/): National reporting and headlines focused on U.S. developments and public affairs.
- [World News](https://www.yahoo.com/news/world/): International coverage of global politics, conflicts, and major world events.
- [Politics](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/): Political news, elections coverage, policy reporting, and analysis.
- [Science](https://www.yahoo.com/news/science/): Science reporting on research, space, climate, and discoveries.
- [Originals](https://www.yahoo.com/news/originals/): Yahoo-produced reporting, interviews, and original editorial features.

## Finance
- [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/): Market data platform for quotes, charts, portfolios, and business news.
- [Trending Tickers](https://finance.yahoo.com/trending-tickers/): Frequently viewed stocks and market movers attracting investor attention.
- [Stock Market News](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/): Financial news covering markets, companies, earnings, and economic developments.
- [Personal Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/): Consumer finance coverage on saving, taxes, retirement, and credit.
- [Crypto](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/crypto/): Cryptocurrency prices, market news, and digital asset coverage.
- [Screeners](https://finance.yahoo.com/screener/): Tools for filtering stocks and securities by financial criteria.
- [Calendar](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/): Earnings, economic, and IPO calendars for upcoming market events.

## Sports
- [Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com/): Sports news, live scores, schedules, fantasy games, and analysis.
- [NFL](https://sports.yahoo.com/nfl/): Football news, scores, standings, schedules, and league coverage.
- [NBA](https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/): Basketball coverage with scores, standings, rumors, and game analysis.
- [MLB](https://sports.yahoo.com/mlb/): Baseball news, scores, standings, and season coverage.
- [NHL](https://sports.yahoo.com/nhl/): Hockey scores, standings, news, and team updates.
- [NCAAF](https://sports.yahoo.com/ncaaf/): College football scores, rankings, schedules, and commentary.
- [NCAAB](https://sports.yahoo.com/ncaab/): College basketball coverage including rankings, scores, and tournament news.

## Fantasy Sports
- [Yahoo Fantasy](https://sports.yahoo.com/fantasy/): Fantasy sports hub for leagues, drafts, rankings, and player tools.
- [Fantasy Football](https://sports.yahoo.com/fantasy/football/): Fantasy football game center with leagues, projections, and draft tools.
- [Fantasy Baseball](https://sports.yahoo.com/fantasy/baseball/): Fantasy baseball platform for roster management, rankings, and scoring.
- [Fantasy Basketball](https://sports.yahoo.com/fantasy/basketball/): Fantasy basketball leagues, player news, and matchup tools.
- [Fantasy Hockey](https://sports.yahoo.com/fantasy/hockey/): Fantasy hockey league management, stats, and player updates.
- [Daily Fantasy](https://sports.yahoo.com/dailyfantasy/): Daily fantasy contests, entries, and player selection tools.

## Entertainment
- [Yahoo Entertainment](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/): Entertainment news covering celebrities, TV, movies, and music.
- [Celebrity](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/celebrity/): Celebrity news, interviews, and trending pop culture stories.
- [TV](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/tv/): Television news, recaps, streaming updates, and show coverage.
- [Movies](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, trailers, releases, and industry reporting.
- [Music](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/music/): Music news, artist coverage, releases, and performances.

## Life, Shopping, and Lifestyle
- [Yahoo Life](https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/): Lifestyle coverage spanning wellness, style, parenting, and relationships.
- [Style](https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/style/): Fashion, beauty, and style trend coverage.
- [Health](https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/health/): Health and wellness reporting, advice, and expert-backed explainers.
- [Parenting](https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/parenting/): Parenting stories, family advice, and child-focused features.
- [Shopping](https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/shopping/): Product recommendations, deals, and consumer shopping guides.
- [In the Know](https://www.intheknow.com/): Yahoo lifestyle and shopping brand focused on trends and recommendations.

## Weather and Local Information
- [Yahoo Weather](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather/): Weather coverage and forecast-related news from Yahoo.
- [Weather on Search](https://search.yahoo.com/search?p=weather): Search results experience for weather forecasts and conditions.
- [Local News](https://www.yahoo.com/news/local/): Local and regional news aggregation where available.

## Tech and Digital Culture
- [Yahoo Tech](https://www.yahoo.com/tech/): Technology news, product coverage, and digital culture reporting.
- [Tech News on Yahoo News](https://www.yahoo.com/news/tech/): Technology reporting within Yahoo News coverage.
- [Creators](https://creators.yahoo.com/): Publishing and creator-focused platform for Yahoo contributors and content.

## Help, Policies, and Company
- [Yahoo Help](https://help.yahoo.com/): Support center for Mail, account, security, and product troubleshooting.
- [Account Security](https://help.yahoo.com/kb/account): Help articles for account access, recovery, and protection.
- [Terms of Service](https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/otos/index.html): Legal terms governing use of Yahoo products and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/privacy/index.html): Privacy practices describing data collection, use, and controls.
- [Advertising](https://www.yahooinc.com/advertising): Yahoo advertising information for brands, publishers, and marketers.
- [Yahoo Inc.](https://www.yahooinc.com/): Corporate site with company information, brands, leadership, and business details.
